```yaml
name: No Response

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # Daily at midnight

jobs:
  no-response:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Check for stale issues
        uses: actions/stale@v9
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          stale-issue-message: |
            This issue has been automatically marked as stale because it has not had recent activity.
            
            It will be closed if no further activity occurs. Thank you for your contributions.
            
            If you believe this is a mistake or have additional information to add, please comment below.
            
            For more information, see our [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/kubb-labs/kubb/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
          days-before-stale: 30
          days-before-close: 7
          exempt-issue-labels: "bug,enhancement,documentation,help wanted"
          stale-issue-label: "stale"
          operations-per-run: 100
          
      - name: Check for stale PRs
        uses: actions/stale@v9
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          stale-pr-message: |
            This pull request has been automatically marked as stale because it has not had recent activity.
            
            It will be closed if no further activity occurs. Thank you for your contributions.
            
            If you believe this is a mistake or have additional information to add, please comment below.
            
            For more information, see our [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/kubb-labs/kubb/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
          days-before-stale: 30
          days-before-close: 7
          exempt-pr-labels: "bug,enhancement,documentation,help wanted"
          stale-pr-label: "stale"
          operations-per-run: 100
```
